stages.name: Sowing
stages.advice: Prepare nursery beds and maintain moisture.

stages.name: Vegetative
stages.advice: Apply nitrogen fertilizer and irrigate every 7 days.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.advice: Avoid water stress; monitor pests closely.

stages.name: Maturity
stages.advice: Reduce irrigation and prepare for harvest.

stages.name: Sowing
stages.advice: Sow seeds at proper depth with basal fertilizer.

stages.name: Heading
stages.advice: Monitor for rust disease and ensure irrigation.
